summary: Current revision 1 plan and contract keep the authorized dedicated Figma project/file, repository-owned three-layer Light/Dark foundation, six families/44 variants, checks, and independent gates. The contract now binds actual Figma exports, final audit, captures, placement evidence, and checker as environment files; registered design document hashes match current artifacts. No new scope or acceptance concern blocks final review. Static evidence and recorded UI placement remain bounded; this plan binding does not assert runtime UI quality.
